files.description: Bike-share stations (48 rows, one per station): station_code (four-digit code with leading zeros, e.g. "0040"), station_name (text, a few with accented letters), district (same 6 districts as riders.csv; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), docks (whole number), opened_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD).

task_text: From stations.csv, read opened_on as a date and, for each station, give the opening year, the day of the year (1 to 366) and the number of whole years the station had been open on 2025-11-01. `result` should be a table with columns station_code (text, leading zeros kept), open_year, open_day_of_year and years_open, in file order.
intended_computation: Read stations.csv keeping station_code as text; opened_on as a date; open_year, open_day_of_year (1-366) and years_open = completed years from opened_on to 2025-11-01. Columns station_code, open_year, open_day_of_year, years_open; file order.

acceptable_variants.notes: id columns (rider_id, station codes) may be written as integers without leading zeros
